title: Cloud, DevOps & AI Operations
description: Cloud architecture, migration, CI/CD and managed AI operations from Techlio: monitoring, evals, cost control and model upgrades on AWS, Azure and Google Cloud.
intro: Launch is where AI systems start to drift: models change, costs creep and quality slips without anyone noticing. We run the cloud, the release pipeline and the AI layer for you, with quality, cost and reliability reported every month.
caption: A developer push triggers the CI pipeline and infrastructure as code, deploys to staging and production, and feeds autoscaling, observability and cost reporting.

card.lead: Deploy on a Tuesday afternoon without holding your breath.
card.text: Cloud architecture, CI/CD and managed AI operations: monitoring, evals, cost control and model upgrades, reported monthly.

offerIntro: Four stages, in order. You can stop after any of them and keep what was built.

offerings.title: Cloud architecture and migration
offerings.text: A target design covering networking, environments, data, security boundaries and cost, with workloads moved in stages and rollback at each step.

offerings.title: CI/CD and infrastructure as code
offerings.text: Automated build, test and deploy pipelines, with every environment defined in version control so it can be recreated on demand.

offerings.title: AI operations
offerings.text: Production answers are sampled and scored against your eval set, token and compute costs are tracked per feature, and model upgrades are tested before they are switched on.

offerings.title: Operate and optimise
offerings.text: Dashboards, alerts and runbooks for the team on call, plus a monthly review of quality, cost and reliability with concrete actions.

why.title: Deploys stop being events
why.text: Small, automated releases with canaries and rollback replace the long, tense deployment evening.

why.title: AI quality is watched, not assumed
why.text: Drift, cost spikes and failed answers are caught by monitoring and evals instead of by your customers.

why.title: Cost you can explain
why.text: Cloud and model spend is tagged by service and feature and reviewed on a schedule, so the bill has no surprises.

closeTitle: Is your infrastructure slowing your releases?
closeText: Describe your current setup and what hurts. We will reply within 24 hours with where we would start.

faqs.question: What is LLMOps?
faqs.answer: The practices for running language-model features in production: tracking answer quality, cost and response time, testing prompt and model changes before release, and rolling back when quality drops.

faqs.question: Which clouds do you work with?
faqs.answer: Mostly AWS, with experience across the major providers. We work in your accounts so you keep ownership and access.

faqs.question: Can you take over a system another team built?
faqs.answer: Yes. We start with a review of the architecture, release process and monitoring, fix the highest risks first, then move to regular operations.

faqs.question: How do you control AI running costs?
faqs.answer: By measuring cost per request, caching and routing simpler tasks to smaller models where quality allows, and setting alerts on spend.

faqs.question: Do you offer ongoing support?
faqs.answer: Yes. Managed operations run under a support agreement with agreed response times.

metaTitle: Cloud, DevOps and Managed AI Operations
answer: Techlio's cloud, DevOps and AI operations service keeps software and AI systems running reliably after launch. We design the cloud architecture, automate testing and releases, monitor quality, cost and latency for AI features, and handle model upgrades so a change never reaches users without being checked.
